business: Tideline Marine Services, Inc. (Commercial Marine Repair & Dock Services)

expectedRedFlags: Legal fees on the disputed drydock account: Largely unsupported. The seller treats these as one-time litigation costs, but they have run every month for over a year and the dispute is unresolved. Only about $23,000 relates to a discrete matter that has actually closed.
Customer concentration: Largest customer, Portage Bay Manufacturing, is 22.9% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 67.9%.
expectedYellowFlags: Owner compensation above market: Partially supportable. About $166,000 of the $246,000 claim exceeds the cost of a yard manager to replace the owner's operating role.
ABS and USCG recertification project: Fully supportable. A discrete recertification cycle in April and May 2025 over and above the routine licensing that runs monthly.

Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $26,147 to $224,784; cash ranges from $1,712,164 to $2,113,946. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
groundTruth.notes: MML M&A Benchmark Deal DD-013: Tideline Marine Services, Inc. (Commercial Marine Repair & Dock Services). Seller claims $1.53M EBITDA vs $1.13M buyer-supported ($402k overstatement).
